sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 432 x 314 x 534 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

NEXO P12 page read 2026-11-12: "534 mm x 432 mm x 314 mm" labelled Height x Width x Depth, 20 kg net, touring and TIS versions "4 x NL4 (4-pole speakON), one per handle plus two at the back" (the install version has one cable gland), a 12 in LF neodymium driver and a 3 in HF diaphragm driver in a coaxial arrangement, "a curvilinear enclosure" of birch and poplar plywood, usable vertically or as a wedge monitor, accessory fittings on both sides and the bottom. Modelled: the two NL4 at the back (of four; the two on the handles are not modelled). The handles have no stated place and are not cut; the shape is a plain rounded box (the page states no angle; radius 8 mm is our estimate). Positions are guesses.
